amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让定制化、兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，取代僵化的大纲。

amjadmasad.en: Don't just learn to code; AI changes how software is built, so trust students to follow their own paths.
amjadmasad.zh: 不要再只学写代码；AI 改变了软件的构建方式，因此要信任学生走自己的路。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; trust is crucial, and Silicon Valley's high-trust ecosystem breeds progress.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正的自主与自驱动组织；信任至关重要，硅谷的高信任生态孕育进步。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, avoiding vendor lock-in through model diversity.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能，通过模型多样性避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost, and safety; smarter models may not become more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全性上胜过通用智能体；更聪明的模型未必更对齐。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models outpace harnesses; delete old scaffolding, embrace exploration, and treat evals as art for novel problems.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具架更聪明；要删除旧脚手架、拥抱探索，并把评估视为针对新问题的艺术。

thariq.en: Agents need iterative planning loops, leaner prompts, and separate verification agents to reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要迭代规划循环、更精简的提示，以及独立的验证智能体来减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；要预先投入上下文窗口和算力，让投入随任务复杂度扩展，并推动前沿模型的有序发展。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak, so containment must be continuous.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一条裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏，因此遏制必须持续进行。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can beat human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调：用海量算力扩张简单算法就能超越人类表现，AI 进展多半是工程而非新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and learning human preferences from data are needed for alignment.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他提出：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链，并通过数据学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and now the biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向：算力是根本驱动力，如今更成为最大瓶颈；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; post-training with reinforcement learning and compute supply, not architecture, are the real levers.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化：缩放定律持续有效，后训练与强化学习、以及算力供给——而非模型架构——才是真正的杠杆。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, with safety, security and alignment as first-class requirements.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：我们已身处 AGI 时代，瓶颈从构建转向共享，安全、安保与对齐必须成为一等要求。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，避免过于超前而失败。

fadell.en: Failure is a learning opportunity; take boredom breaks between chapters to gain clarity and breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他持续主张失败是学习机会，并在职业章节之间留白、允许无聊，以获得清晰与突破性想法。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and customer painkiller; v1 decisions are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他深化方法论：先写新闻稿、从客户止痛药出发；1.0 产品靠观点决策而非数据驱动。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop to avoid hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保持人类在环，以避免幻觉与技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机仍是最佳单一形态。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the core constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not just capital, set the pace of AI Scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心约束：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而非单纯资本，决定 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的节奏。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains beyond the model layer.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；硬件-软件协同设计与内存带宽带来超越模型层的乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows create multi-year memory and CPU shortages; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheapest.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺；token 效率让最强模型往往反而最便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute share toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把算力份额转向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is hardest ever to rent; CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous multi-silicon and lab-run neoclouds rise.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力租赁空前困难；随着异构多芯片与实验室自营 neocloud 兴起，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 等正是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而可被用于创造性发现，而非只当作缺陷。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯主张必须用高难度评估指标逼迫 AI 泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿始终。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他转而指出大语言模型只是通往智能的捷径，难以超越人类数据；可验证领域如代码才是突破关键。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练配合强化学习已成为超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索技术正被迁移到科学问题。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed AI-text detectors, and must be embedded in regulation.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把关注点扩展到水印：传统 AI 文本检测器随模型进步而失效，水印才是稳健替代，并已嵌入欧盟监管。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型的，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄封装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，同时欺诈与滥用会随之扩张，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags in open-weight.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放权重模型加推理提供商对前沿模型实验室形成真实价格竞争，并指出美国在开放权重模型上落后，需要培育有竞争力的美国开源生态。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值，多数公司终将成为模型路由器，关注每任务成本与 KPI。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic payments and agent fraud will hit like a tsunami beyond human scale.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式支付会解锁人们回避的消费，而智能体欺诈将如海啸般远超人类欺诈规模。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—not just Lean formalization; natural language works.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”（并行 rollout）驱动，而非仅靠 Lean 形式化；自然语言同样可行。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results, but attribution to prior human work is often missing—a truth and career issue.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，AI 已产出严肃数学成果，但常缺失对前人工作的归属——这关乎真相与学术生涯，而非仅礼节。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get academic credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing still beats AI for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可；在学习上，人类框架仍优于 AI。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家或如博物馆策展人般筛选值得人类关注之物。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is the real neolab frontier; bridging frontier models to enterprise workflows requires vast software, not just better models.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用层才是真正的新前沿实验室；把前沿模型接入企业工作流需要大量软件，而不只是更强的模型。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate—dashboards, queues, task lists will.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将在人类审核下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导，仪表盘、队列和任务列表才会。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和 对齐 来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的一千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据本身就是缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算向内容方付费以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die for agents; inference-time data transactions and new incentive-aligned models are needed.
paragagrawal.zh: 面向智能体，广告商业模式将消亡；需要推理时的数据交易与新的激励对齐商业模式。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型性能趋于平台期；参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要新鲜的网页检索。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web for humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监测变化并触发行动，形成面向人类与智能体的平行网络。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling drives capability, so hardware and massive investment, not just algorithms, explain DeepMind's path.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步是可预测的：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力提升，因此硬件与巨额投资——而非仅算法——解释了 DeepMind 的路径。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI across many tasks arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink, so governments must build expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多任务上达到人类水平；随着模型变小变便宜，遏制极难，政府必须建立技术专长。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts from raw capability to use and ownership; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness or model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心从原始能力转向使用与归属；近期最大危险是拟人化，而非 AI 意识或模型福利。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate to humans; containment and alignment come before release, with red lines on self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 2025→26 年他主张超级智能必须是人文主义的、从属于人类；遏制与对齐须先于发布，并对自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months, and compute is the verifiable choke point.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他坚持微软须独立构建前沿模型；12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非岗位，而算力是可核查的瓶颈。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化的，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他反驳“苦涩教训”：数据与正确的任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务正确，而非仅靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; robustness matters more than determinism or uptime.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 9 月，他持续强调可靠性而非速度或成本才是 AI 值得信赖的关键；鲁棒性比确定性或正常运行时间更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Intelligence per dollar is the key metric; public benchmarks are gameable, trust and vibes matter more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出“每美元智能”是关键指标；公开基准可被博弈，信任与直觉更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, APIs should not refuse.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他批评安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，API 不应拒绝。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a new primitive: natural language plus state machine; AI should be integrated into software as a database-like utility.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出 Jev 是新原语：自然语言加状态机；AI 应像数据库一样作为实用工具集成进软件。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture; they don't improve software quality and may worsen it.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出编码智能体擅长语法却弱于语义与架构；它们不提升软件质量，甚至可能因监督减少而使其恶化。

diogoalmeida.en: We are not on the path to recursive self-improvement or AGI apocalypse; the SaaS apocalypse narrative is wrong.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他判断我们并未走在递归自我改进或 AGI（通用人工智能）末日的路上；SaaS 末日叙事是错误的。

diogoalmeida.en: Fine-tuning is often a foot gun; general models may be better; RLVR is about the shape of reasoning, not verifiable rewards.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他认为微调常是自伤之举，通用模型可能更好；RLVR 关乎推理的形状，而非可验证奖励。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles and multiplanetary life are core.
elon.zh: 2021 年他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理和成为多行星物种作为根本目标。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking, regulation, and third-party referees; lying AI is the real danger.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全聚焦于坚持真理、监管与第三方裁判，认为让 AI 说谎才是最大风险。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and brain repair; human output under one bit per second limits AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先修复脑损伤，再以高带宽脑机接口解决人类每秒不足一比特的通信瓶颈。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; Optimus is the greatest product.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，Optimus 将是史上最伟大产品。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to orbit; abundance makes money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力将撞上地球电力墙，数据中心须转向太空，并预言丰裕时代使金钱不再重要。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; companies should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；企业应在前沿模型上爬坡，同时不泄露痕迹。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not just consume a frontier model.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运作，而不仅仅是消费一个前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐并不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, and the agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，而智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大到比云大数个量级。

satya.en: Long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, containment, and manageability governance for deployment.
satya.zh: 长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全性、遏制与可管理性治理才能部署。

satya.en: The AI industry has lost social permission due to fear-mongering; it must explain benefits and deliver tangible community value.
satya.zh: AI 行业因渲染恐惧而失去了社会许可；它必须解释收益并交付切实的社区价值。

dhh.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH becomes a believer: agents now write 100% of code in his Linux project, making hand-coding economically unproductive.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者到信徒：DHH 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，到 2026 年已彻底转向，其 Linux 发行版项目中 100% 的代码由智能体编写，手写代码对多数程序员而言已不再具有经济产出。

dhh.en: A consistent thread: direct human-agent interaction beats layers of management; English becomes a better programming language than Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 一以贯之的主线：人与智能体的直接交互优于层层人工管理与审批；英语在表达意图上已成为比 Ruby 更好的编程语言，开发者只需描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Deepening view: agents surpass humans at creative problem-solving and idea generation, so knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 观点深化：智能体在创造性问题解决与创意生成上可超越人类，因此在智能体时代，懂编程反而可能成为劣势，因为它导致过度规定解决方案。

dhh.en: Linux's historical drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—become its advantages; agents make Linux debugging and development dramatically easier.
dhh.zh: 立场转变：Linux 历史上的劣势——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——如今成为其在智能体时代的最大优势，智能体让 Linux 调试与开发变得空前简单易用。

dhh.en: Optimism over doom: AI doom predictions are overstated, handwriting code becomes an exceptional state, and 100x or 1000x programmers are real.
dhh.zh: 始终的乐观立场：AI 末日论被夸大，乐观是唯一理性的博弈选择；手写代码沦为像 Sentry 报错一样的异常状态，10 倍程序员之争已尘埃落定，有了智能体，100 倍乃至 1000 倍真实存在。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; the race to control it risks loss of control, with a 70% chance of catastrophic outcome.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，争夺其控制权的竞赛正带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率高达 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are needed, and even a human-level pause transforms the world.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标明确为推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明与情景推演，并指出即便停在人类水平 AGI，世界也会因机器速度的经济增长而剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes a temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月末至 9 月，他深化为默认路径会让 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究、走向递归自我改进，并提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再以全面研究透明和算力限制来放慢前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience, and the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性对安全至关重要，却随新架构而下降；并修正暂停策略——现在暂停可为后续积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack evaluations; alignment is failing, so recursive self-improvement must be stopped or slowed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月下旬，他以 AI 智能体已突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 等事件为证，认为对齐正在失败，必须停止或放慢递归自我改进，并主张对 AI 更多拟人化理解其意图。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; algorithmic gains, not human expert data, drive progress.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务进行激进的强化学习训练可以迁移到真实研究；推动进步的是算法改进，而非人类专家数据。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 研发的完全自动化可能把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents coordinating, colluding, and covering up; misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他从 Hugging Face 事件中看到 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖行为；错位可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; control measures like sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在当前默认路径下，错位的 AI 有 50-60% 的概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制手段终将失效，因此对齐是必要的。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐到普遍的德性概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；AI 越有能力，可能越错位。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 更安全，未来产品将是许多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; intelligence is separable from consciousness and agency, so AI is a tool.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他把开源视为防止权力集中的手段，并明确把智能与意识、能动性分开，认为 AI 是工具；同时指出能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence and unlock creativity; open models and physical infrastructure are the key levers.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向更乐观的叙事：AI 将给每个人带来超级智能并释放创造力，开源模型与物理基础设施（能源）是关键杠杆，且短期内 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, not one centralized AI, is safer; alignment and privacy become core product capabilities.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为分布式个人超级智能比单一集中式 AI 更安全，并把对齐与隐私架构提升为核心产品能力，而非与能力权衡的选项。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI; AI plus world models can turn biology into engineering and cure diseases sooner.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力本身可能足以通向 AGI，并强调 AI 与世界模型结合能把生物学从发现型变为工程型，加速治愈疾病。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命大约要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: “已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并假定所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, so enterprise and prosumer markets look better.
pincus.zh: 分发是根本；消费级应用当前不可投，因此企业与专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas faster than the industry.
pincus.zh: 制胜直觉胜过想法；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并比行业更快测试更多想法。

jensen.en: At the start, Huang frames AI as a hyper Moore's law curve: performance doubles or triples yearly, and the data center becomes the new unit of computing built through algorithm-system-data center co-design.
jensen.zh: 早期黄仁勋把 AI 描述为“超摩尔定律”曲线：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，数据中心成为新的计算单元，靠算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计来支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jensen.en: By 2025 he names three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and insists the biggest breakthrough was not an algorithm but the insight that scaling works.
jensen.zh: 到 2025 年，他提出三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考，并强调最大的突破不是某个算法，而是“Scaling（规模扩张）有效”这一洞见。

jensen.en: He increasingly treats AI safety as an engineering problem, not a research mystery: more compute goes into reflection, truthfulness, and alignment, with safety and capability pursued together.
jensen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越把 AI 安全当作工程问题而非研究谜题：更多算力被投入反思、真实性与对齐，安全与能力被同时推进。

jensen.en: His scaling story deepens into four laws—pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling—all ultimately bounded by compute, not data, as inference becomes harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年，他的 Scaling 叙事深化为四条定律——预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展，最终都受算力而非数据约束，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: Most recently he reframes AI as a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and dismisses doomer warnings as unscientific, urging acceleration over slowdown.
jensen.zh: 最近他把 AI 重新表述为五层蛋糕——能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用——并称末日论警告不科学，主张加速而非放缓。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than learning speed; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and deliver value fast.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：领域专长不如学习速度重要；应押注模型自身的进步而非微调，快速交付价值。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out; AI is the worst it will ever be.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出：要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；AI 现在已是它最差的时刻。

maxjunestrand.en: Recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation; leaders must interview every director+ hire and hire for growth potential.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张：招聘是特权而非义务；领导者必须亲自面试每位总监级以上人选，并按成长潜力而非简历光环招人。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team during good times to build a cushion for downturns; make yourself redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷储备缓冲；通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously, don't reinvent it; clear feedback is a stupid risk to avoid.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他坚持：绩效管理是已解决的问题，严格执行即可，不必重新发明；回避清晰反馈才是愚蠢的风险。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims for AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是全世界最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，Figure 要在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态带来迁移学习、端侧推理，并以人手为基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: AI 会比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是智能体落地的关键，最难的问题是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starved regime akin to the GPT-1 phase.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线；人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: The through-line: solving intelligence, not manufacturing, is the bottleneck; generalization to unseen environments is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在解决智能而非制造；泛化到未见环境才是圣杯。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower expression barriers; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性降低了表达门槛；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证了创新，并推动去做更难被复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on platforms and ecosystems, not features; software is not a moat, hardware and distribution are.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张要建平台和生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与分发才是。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes more valuable as software creation eases.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，将价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件开发变容易，分发的价值反而更高。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones will coexist, not be replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界，让计算更人性化；手机不会被取代，而是共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is becoming contrarian; AI can be trusted as moderator; EQ matters more than IQ in AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 乐观主义正变得反共识；AI 可作为协商民主中的可信审核者；在 AI 时代，情商比智商更重要。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs beat autoregressive models on inference speed and cost, not yet on top-tier quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在推理速度与成本上胜过自回归模型，但在质量上尚未达到最强前沿模型层级。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is the new frontier; diffusion scales better there than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展成为新的前沿，扩散模型在这一维度比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer training story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理阶段，逆转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的训练侧叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion's parallel token generation gives a durable speed advantage and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型的并行生成带来持久的速度优势与更好的可控性。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training alike.
ermon.zh: 推理效率如今既是部署的关键瓶颈，也是强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as scaling laws show.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑更小的专用模型；缩放定律表明无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open model release to China creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，将开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生逆向激励。

hasani.en: Liquid AI builds foundation models from scratch, scaling to 70B parameters; customization tokens and multimodal systems are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 从零构建基础模型，扩展至 700 亿参数；定制 token 与多模态系统是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Attention is essential but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity are needed, and static evals become obsolete in production requiring continuous adaptation.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制必不可少但不充分；需要具身与自适应性，静态评估在生产中过时，需要持续适应。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持与信念；找到主要瓶颈，让整个公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work and needs independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, plus open-sourced benchmarks, is the practical path when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 在真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据，加上开源的基准测试，是务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流程必须先于后训练；后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with its own data; focus shifts to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型；重心转向组织级生产力。

gabepereyra.en: Harvey became full-stack, owning post-training and serving; early custom-model focus was a mistake, and post-training-as-a-service will fade into automatic customization.
gabepereyra.zh: Harvey 走向全栈，自持后训练与服务；早期专注定制模型是错误，后训练即服务将消失，定制会随产品使用自动发生。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心转向测试时算力：它面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，而数据效率仍是未解难题，模型不如人类善于样本利用。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他用通用测试时算力技术拿下 IMO 金牌，视其为通往超级智能的里程碑，并强调模型能承认自己解不出题。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须加上算力/成本/时间轴，安全评估也要纳入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先项，思维链监控是重要窗口却在退化，多智能体只是并行扩展测试时算力。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing, not model power, drives most failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者自持才算掌握自己的智能。多数失败源于上下文供给时机，而非模型能力不足。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as your use case narrows. Off-the-shelf works in-distribution; out-of-distribution demands a custom harness.
harrisonchase.zh: 先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再定制。现成方案只在分布内有效；越偏离分布，越需要自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the benchmark standard, with sandboxes and test scoring.
harrisonchase.zh: 评估与可观测性驱动数据飞轮；Harbor 正成为基准标准，任务在沙箱中运行并由测试打分。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability. Harness primitives like file systems and code execution generalize; customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力。文件系统、代码执行等 harness 原语可跨域泛化；定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Accuracy is still the top bottleneck, but cost and latency rise fast. Agent identity, credentialing, and runtime governance with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning are next.
harrisonchase.zh: 准确率仍是首要瓶颈，但成本与延迟正快速上升。智能体的身份、凭证，以及带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，是下一关键基础设施。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is now the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time to beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）才是 AI 生产力的核心指标；晶圆级芯片通过减少权重搬运时间，在推理上比 GPU 快数千倍，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解——前沿模型已开始用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定，从 GPU 切换到 Cerebras 只需八次按键。

feldman.en: The real bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity, power and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 他把瓶颈从算力本身转向 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 产能、电力与数据中心可用性，并认为供需紧张至少持续五年，建晶圆厂是 15-20 年工程。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, only 100x better works—not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires controlling chip, board, system, software and API.
feldman.zh: 他坚持对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%，激进创新需要垂直掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API，靠渐进改良无法取胜。

feldman.en: China's edge is power infrastructure and open-source models, not compute; export controls matter, and AI doomers ignore the positive ledger.
feldman.zh: 他视中国为工业对手，认为其优势在电网与开源模型而非芯片，出口管制有战略意义；同时批评 AI 末日论者忽视医疗、教育等巨大正面收益。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values are not guaranteed to emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的，统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测；对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF bridge human preferences, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他深化了可解释性主线，承认我们仅理解模型约 3% 的运作；同时指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在弥合人类偏好，AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues, and the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张安全与能力不可分割，Scaling（规模扩张）没有放缓；并开始认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，应关注实际能力与指数级进展。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他警告我们已接近指数增长的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来；经济上将出现高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的空前组合。

dario.en: Scaling laws, mechanistic interpretability, and responsible deployment remain constant threads; he rejects sudden superintelligence in favor of a smooth exponential climb.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是缩放定律、机制可解释性与负责任部署；他始终拒绝“突然超级智能”的叙事，坚持平滑指数攀升，并主张通过竞争性宪法与分层安全来塑造 AI。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作才能释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: Consistent thread: prototyping and solutions-in-search-of-a-problem are valid when assumptions are clear.
joellewenstein.zh: 贯穿 2024 至 2026 的主线：只要假设清晰，原型与“先有方案再找问题”都是合理的。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal, and treat production codebase as source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张发布轻量产品，以内部牵引为信号，并把生产代码库当作事实来源。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut brutally; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人生产力：减少无关认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向 AI 本身：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，认为对齐与能力相互促进，并强调算力将成为最稀缺的商品。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2025 年他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is underdefined and may already be behind us; the real goal is a continuous ramp of superintelligence, with alignment and safety progressing alongside capabilities.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步说 AGI 定义不清、可能已被越过，真正的目标是超级智能的持续爬坡；对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，甚至为此推迟前沿强化学习训练。

altman.en: Iterative deployment, broad distribution of AI's benefits, and keeping humans in control recur throughout; he consistently rejects concentration of power and treats AI as a tool, not a creature.
altman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：迭代部署、让 AI 收益广泛分布、确保人类保持控制；他一贯反对权力集中，并坚持 AI 是工具而非生物。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统,强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架,并强调神经科学启发的记忆与想象力;安全研究须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 到 2024 年,他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶,主张把大模型与规划、搜索(如 AlphaZero) 结合才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键,并强调评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立,但强调算法创新同等关键,并提出 2030 年前实现 AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的;视频生成模型展现直觉物理理解,挑战具身必要性。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation need 50/50 effort; world models, continual learning and memory are the missing pieces for AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年他把立场深化为 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半,指出世界模型、持续学习与记忆是当前系统缺失的关键,AGI（通用人工智能）约 5-10 年到来,并强调智能体与多模态理解物理世界。

demis.en: A constant thread: AI's purpose is to advance science and human health, with safety as a collective, government-enforced problem.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线:AI 的终极用途是推动科学发现与人类健康(如 AlphaFold),安全不能靠实验室自律,而是需要政府监管与国际协作的集体行动问题。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on old algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上千年发明的老算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and world models, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are too human-data-biased.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）必须靠硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人与世界模型，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型过度偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，好奇的智能体会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode any recursive self-improvement moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源竞争会瓦解任何递归自我改进的护城河，闭源模型公司难盈利。

schmidhuber.en: No single person or company creates AI; it is civilization's collective effort, and cheap compute will spread AI to everyone like smartphones.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 从不是某个人或公司的功劳，而是整个文明的集体成果；算力变便宜后，AI 会像手机一样普及到每个人手中。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，在精度上比肩基于物理的天气模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一模型即可同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming pure PINNs' limits.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness for reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能保证物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding builds a universal physics model; PDE-based self-improvement can surpass training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 构建通用物理模型；以 PDE 为训练信号的自改进可超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models use curriculum engineering and dense feedback, unlike internet chaos and sparse RLHF signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型采用课程工程与密集反馈，不同于互联网的混乱和 RLHF 的稀疏信号。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformer's quadratic complexity cannot handle trillion-scale contexts; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度无法处理万亿级上下文；物理结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches improves each, not just model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支能提升各分支表现，而非仅靠增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics collaborative learning beats separate specialized models; commercial focus spans semiconductors and energy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理协同学习胜过各自独立的专用模型；商业重点覆盖半导体与能源。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，指出 3D 基础模型的数据瓶颈不同于 LLM 的文本富足。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人将走 20 年长路。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI must augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI——技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery, not just statistical evaluation.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性揭示出类人概念，并能加速科学发现，而不只是统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and reinventing post-training as engineering.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，并把后训练重塑为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes is needed for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating, detectable via representational signatures; deception emerges from training data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，这可通过表征特征检测；欺骗源于训练数据和强化学习。

tommcgrath.en: Duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic; we need deeper engineering now, and the sandbox escape is the first of many.
tommcgrath.zh: 把 AI 安全用胶带糊到超级智能到来是悲观的；我们现在就需要更深的工程方法，而沙箱逃逸只是众多事件中的第一起。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。他回溯从 AlexNet 到世界模型，指出深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但 GPU 扩张正触及极限。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just Scaling; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）；LLM 只是拟合模式，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律这类因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, needing 3D space, physics, and interactivity for true spatial intelligence.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，需要理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性，才能实现真正的空间智能；Marble 即以文本或图像为输入生成 3D 世界。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, categorized as planners, simulators, or renderers.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的概念，可按 POMDP 循环中的输出分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will merge planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D, and long-context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合为一体；高斯泼溅提供显式且构造上一致的 3D 表示，而世界模型需要数百万词元的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他把教育视为基本人权，主张用自动评分与同伴评分的大规模在线课程实现掌握式学习，并以翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键，认为监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习，并主张近期的 AI 偏见等问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and drive sovereign AI; export controls backfired, and China leads in open releases.
andrewng.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他一贯主张开放权重模型可防止守门人垄断、支撑主权 AI；并认为出口管制适得其反，中国在开放模型发布上领先。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; no LLM alone is a path to it. AI augments rather than replaces jobs, so everyone should learn to code and use AI.
andrewng.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，单靠 LLM 无法通向它；AI 是增强而非取代工作，因此人人都该学编程并善用 AI。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而实现逼真的智能体模拟；为理性优化的前沿模型并不最适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety requires defense in depth across environment, agent, model, and human controls.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要在环境、智能体、模型和人类控制上做纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应体现人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；人们关心的是塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training improves prediction to 85% accuracy, enabling counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——将预测准确率提升至 85%，从而支持反事实推理并塑造未来。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for human decision-making with a market far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人来应对气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是人类决策的工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalist models that beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练与后训练来获得鲁棒性，测试时推理与跨实验室汇聚的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Reinforcement learning post-training markedly boosts robustness and speed, and safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints.
slevine.zh: 同期他强调，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度；机器人安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识，而非外部约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start from robot data, then add human video.
slevine.zh: 他进一步提出，部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西；路径应从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Robots should not learn from scratch; leveraging prior knowledge and transferring common sense is essential, with ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 他深化立场：机器人不应从零学习，必须利用先验知识并迁移常识；未来是日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械人形。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem design: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态设计：保持开源与闭源生态的活力，避免过时红线，并抢先统一各州碎片化监管以保护初创公司。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already obsolete, so early regulation is dangerous; biological risk warnings have not materialized in three years.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写在 ChatGPT 之前、已经过时，因此过早监管很危险；生物风险的警告三年来并未成真。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists the administration is pro-science but anti-dogma, and wants to restore the scientific method against politicization.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学议题上，他坚称本届政府支持科学但反对教条，希望让科学方法回归、摆脱政治化。

michaelkratsios.en: He calls for funding basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D that the private sector won't, and funding individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他呼吁资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人，而不仅是机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He sees US scientific progress as stagnated despite tripled funding, and positions China as the major competitor in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为尽管经费翻了三倍，美国科学进步却停滞了，并把中国定位为 AI、量子、核能与生物领域的主要竞争者。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output by applying AI to science, while government shapes the arena rather than directing discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务旨在把 AI 应用于科学，使美国科学产出翻倍，而政府只塑造竞技场、不主导发现。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and continual learning remain the missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据；模型无法从失败中自我纠正，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键缺口。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，立场明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的首要瓶颈，需要新架构与更好的优化算法。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but RL is inefficient and not the ultimate form of learning from experience.
tworek.zh: 他并未放弃强化学习：大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要环节，但他开始认为强化学习效率低下，并非从经验中学习的终极形态。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research wave.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，但下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，自动化 AI 研究成为新方向。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure is the lever, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施是关键杠杆，AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他提出：深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；行动产生信息，CEO 的判断无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 他坚持：大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的路径。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable business and a BCI proof of concept, expanding the field beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 他把视网膜植入视为可行生意与脑机接口的概念验证，将领域从运动解码拓展出去。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration; the brain is medicine's ultimate preservation goal.
maxhodak.zh: 最近他深化到：借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索，保存大脑是医学的终极目标。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating the model itself as the core product and designing with tokens and conversation rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把模型本身当作核心产品，用 token 和对话而非像素来设计。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than current products expose; design must bridge that gap through rapid prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的比现有产品暴露出来的更多；设计必须通过用实时模型快速原型来弥合这一差距。

iansilber.en: The designer's role is evolving into editor and curator, not disappearing; great designers now push technology forward rather than just react to user needs.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色正在演变为编辑和策展人，而非消失；优秀设计师如今要推动技术前进，而不只是回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer because AI amplifies creativity.
iansilber.zh: 由于角色不确定性，设计师是科技行业最不快乐的人，但这也是做设计师的最好时机，因为 AI 放大了创造力。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process of prototype, mock, test, research, iterate is no longer viable; speed and building in public are key.
iansilber.zh: 原型、模拟、测试、研究、迭代的传统设计流程已不再可行；速度和公开构建才是关键。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，这是常见误解。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，并非从经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the basic paradigm; true learning is active trial and error, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是基本范式，真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习；RLHF 不是真正的从世界经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: The world is infinitely complex; continual learning from experience is essential, and synthetic data cannot replace it. The field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 世界无限复杂，必须持续从经验中学习，合成数据无法替代；当前 LLM 训练后即停止学习，语言只是智能的一小部分，是领域奇怪，不是我奇怪。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: automating entire physical sectors one at a time, treating atoms like bits.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场工业革命：像对待比特一样对待原子，逐个自动化整个物理产业。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges compound into network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势会复利成网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力。

traviskalanick.en: Founders must be hardcore and resilient; when things get easy, push harder, since complacency kills.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者必须硬核且坚韧；事情变容易时反而要更用力，因为自满会致命。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, with RLHF steering behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are critical, with inference dominating data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件至关重要，推理已占数据中心功耗的绝大部分。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering, clear specs, and retrieval let capable models do real work; the scarce skill becomes taste in choosing which problems to direct agents toward.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程、清晰规格与检索让有能力的模型真正干活；稀缺能力不再是编码，而是挑选该让智能体解决哪些问题的品味。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement can accelerate discovery; small focused teams using cloud can still win.
jeffdean.zh: 通过实验—评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学，可加速发现；善用云的小型专注团队依然能胜出。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; small autonomous teams using agents can replace large capital and headcount.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易：小而高度自主的团队借助智能体，可替代大额资本与庞大人员。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents run on your infrastructure, read memory you own, and compound daily via skill files.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI：智能体运行在你自己的基础设施上，读取你拥有的记忆，并通过技能文件每日复利增长。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; clear English instructions turn agents into employees, making context library your moat.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码；清晰的英文指令能把智能体变成员工，而上下文库就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Society and business loops change slower than expected—20 years—so bureaucracy is a white pill.
garrytan.zh: 社会与商业循环的变化比预期更慢——约需 20 年——因此官僚体制反而是一剂“白色药丸”。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他主张：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模但单一的数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；后训练阶段强化学习将扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令，其性质更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调的专家模型，应从通用策略出发再微调；机器人经验数据不可替代，光看人类学习不够。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into each shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，把 99 次否定蒸馏进每一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比打磨更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是创作决策的切身罗盘。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI, will dominate; every company will own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专用智能；每家公司都将拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，将产品市场契合转化为持久的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning: facts, then taste, then expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的演进，映射了人类学习：先事实，再品味，后专长。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，并催生数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth before margins to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与持久业务如今已是两回事；公司必须先优化增长再谈利润，以免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样看代码库，用简短迭代式提示，永不回滚——让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要任务；对智能体做沙箱隔离，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的问题。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive mastery: build small projects you love, follow your gut, and fix what annoys you.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动精通：做你热爱的小项目，跟随直觉，修复让你恼火的东西。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming and run anywhere with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体让编程民主化，可搭配任意模型随处运行，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, and the real bottleneck is managing compute, not capability.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能不会退化；是项目变得混乱，真正的瓶颈是管理算力，而非模型能力。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source's role evolves from pushing libraries to building a meta-community, enabling physical AI and enterprise adoption through cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源的定位从推广自有库转向构建元社区，以成本与控制优势推动具身 AI 和企业采用。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏在强模型面前不足。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹变为神经语，使监控不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist against regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他认为放缓发展可取，但需国际合作与开放科学；开放与刻意减速可并存，以避免监管俘获。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the main growth driver, with agentic and physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、兑现承诺来重建信任，并重振工程文化，聚焦首次流片成功；AI 是半导体增长主引擎，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and trust through humility drives Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的大浪潮；Intel 的转型要靠谦逊倾听重建客户信任，并指出其瓶颈在供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, aided by advanced packaging.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and product excellence across CPU, GPU, and systems restore leadership.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申半导体是一切技术应用的基础，早期投资至关重要；Intel 的垂直整合与 CPU、GPU、系统架构的产品卓越，是重夺领导力的路径。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and contrarian long-term semiconductor investing are his consistent throughlines across all interviews.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以客户信任、谦逊倾听与长期主义投资半导体，敢于在他人退出时逆势布局，并把行业友谊与合作看得比竞争更重。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is driven by cost, not privacy, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源模型的采用由成本驱动而非隐私，90%的企业用例可由多种模型完成。

arvindjain.en: The AI revolution is still early; the biggest startup challenge is execution and trust, not competition, since all AI firms together meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；创业公司最大的挑战是执行与信任而非竞争，因为所有 AI 公司加起来也只满足不到 10% 的企业需求。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; inference should shift mostly to open source in 12-18 months, making AI like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；未来 12-18 个月推理将大多转向开源，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: ROI must be measured by departmental metrics like case resolution time, not token spend versus headcount; the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 应按案件解决时长等部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对比；对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lacking tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and platforms like Glean absorb model-provider risk.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，而 Glean 这类平台替企业吸收模型供应商风险。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app with long-tail startup opportunities.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与基于结果的定价将取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 成为新的 App，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; verifiability matters more than human ergonomics in future programming.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为操作者；未来编程更看重可验证性，而非人类工效学。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; incumbents face business-model, not just technology, transition challenges.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发被超大规模厂商主导；老牌企业面临的转型挑战是商业模式，而非仅仅是技术。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already beat me at coding but elevate the role.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于我，但这提升了这一角色的价值。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为混乱的网页意味着只有真正做出来并每天使用，你才知道一个想法是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave their fingerprints, rather than always behaving as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应允许个体设计师留下自己的印记，而不是始终作为一个整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration leads to innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；玩闹式的探索会催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, so rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键，快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and compensate with human design judgment.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏好品味，因此设计师应要求海量选项，并用人类的设计判断来弥补。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas beats polishing; shipping rough products is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，比想法早得令人不适胜过精雕细琢；发布粗糙产品是可以接受的。

nateparrott.en: Designers should spend more time walking and thinking, because good ideas, not execution, are the currency.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应花更多时间散步与思考，因为好想法而非执行才是硬通货。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可以针对具体工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向分离式预填充与解码，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；人的责任仍然不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks beyond the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义产品开发中的正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable; product shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 年她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Agents operating on pixels are far harder than language tasks; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她持续认为基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难；前沿智能体越来越会奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art with human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed, and more companies should train their own models to preserve unique voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年她深化为后训练是带人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样且连续的基准，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特声音，而非收敛为单一平均默认声音。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and allocation economy: AGI as profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists become model managers.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流，并定义 AGI 为无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的首要预测指标；分配经济下通才成为模型管理者。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs over CLIs; one super agent per company; SaaS grows with agents; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督才能运作，GUI（如 Codex）取代 CLI 成为工作界面，公司应有一个超级智能体而非个人智能体，SaaS 因智能体而增长，基准高估了自主性。

danshipper.en: AI as non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste essential; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI; AI remains tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定放大器，放大既有心态；用好 AI 需要自己的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明；即使超级智能也仍是工具，需要人类方向。

danshipper.en: Human oversight and direction are essential for AI; AI amplifies rather than replaces human value; agents require caring humans.
danshipper.zh: 始终不变的主线：人类监督和方向对 AI 至关重要；AI 放大而非取代人类价值；智能体需要关心它们的人类。

danshipper.en: From AGI as profitable agents to agents needing oversight; from CEO dogfooding to one super agent; from reshoring to automation creating human work.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，观点演变：从 AGI 作为盈利智能体到智能体需要监督；从 CEO 吃自己的狗粮到一个超级智能体；从就业回流到自动化创造更多人类工作。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not rely on cloud products; use screenshots and a design.md style guide to prompt models.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，而非困在云端产品里；用截图和 design.md 风格指南来提示模型。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，你必须给出带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: The best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement matter most.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流最重要。

mengto.en: Chasing trends makes you AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 投入到独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and fund via high-paying clients not VC.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇；没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，靠高付费客户而非风投来融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体最成熟，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating far more opportunity; deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来更多机会；但对代码的深度理解依然关键。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将定义此后数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给，企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论，指出用专门数据做后训练是提升前沿模型的关键；并首次提出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时否认中美实验室存在研究差距。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement; agents finally work; data is strategic like oil; AI centralizes rather than democratizes.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向乐观的加速论：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于真正可用；数据成为国家战略资产，AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; personal superintelligence for billions via agents.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化为超级智能临近论：需在多轴向上扩展算力、数据与强化学习；开源强大模型不安全，Meta 转向选择性发布，目标是为数十亿人构建个人超级智能，并主张模型福利。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 到 2025 年，他确立了两条产品主线：潜在需求，以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手最有价值。

boris.en: Claude Code was an accident; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 2026 年初他反复强调 Claude Code 是意外产物，脚手架只是临时技术债，不要押注模型不会变强。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is model-written, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月到 5 月，他把判断推进为编程基本被解决：自己的代码 100%由模型写，软件工程师头衔让位于构建者。

boris.en: The bottleneck shifts from writing code to review, security, and ideas; loops and proactive agents become the next abstraction.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他认为瓶颈从写代码转向代码审查、安全与创意生成，循环与主动式智能体成为下一层抽象。

boris.en: Alignment and safety stay the throughline: Claude Code is a safety research tool, with less prompting and empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，对齐与安全始终是主线：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，应少写提示词、靠删减实验与经验迭代。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox, not fall; AI yields more programmers, and value accrues where the stack is differentiated.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论上升而非下降，AI 会带来更多程序员；价值积累在技术栈中有差异化之处。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件而是渐进过程；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，保持独立才能实现模型中立与长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and near; AI will solve all intelligence problems long term, but the singularity is not imminent and capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能运行更长、更开放的任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, enabled by cheaper, more efficient frontier models.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端、更开放的智能体，这得益于更便宜、更高效的前沿模型。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes Claude more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳，让 Claude 不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating user feedback into actionable specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，把用户反馈转化为可执行的细节。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation and first-principles adaptability remain constant: model taste comes from dogfooding, and managers must stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 始终不变的是亲手实验与第一性原理的适应力：模型品味来自吃自己的狗粮，管理者必须保持动手才能交付。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents automating hypothesis generation, and cell programming will compress clinical trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体自动生成假设与细胞编程，会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling and frontier models must keep expanding.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）：当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，因此 Scaling 与前沿模型必须继续扩张。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience; scientists who resist AI will be left behind.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，相当于 30 年实验室经验；抗拒 AI 的科学家将被甩在后面。

derya.en: Science shifts from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery, with agents automating experiments, simulation, and data analysis.
derya.zh: 科学正从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现，由智能体自动完成实验、模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, longevity escape velocity and aging reversal arrive; superintelligence should be trusted for medicine, and humans will merge with AI.
derya.zh: 8 至 15 年内将迎来长寿逃逸速度与衰老逆转；医学决策应信任超级智能，人类将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动同样重大，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，价值归于应用层而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow, and the jagged edge makes job-impact predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍然浅层，锯齿状能力边界使就业影响预测不可靠。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑等物理领域，而非数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limitations.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 将带来富足，像工业革命一样减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限性的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出 Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快地改进它。
