qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调最困难的部分不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器中的扩散；监管总是滞后。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他深化观点：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟，从而能更高效地训练物理 AI。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws now hit diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，缩放定律如今已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and lack metacognition.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，且系统缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning, search, and modularity combined with end-to-end optimization are needed.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；需要推理、搜索，以及模块化与端到端优化的结合。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation for reliability.
danklein.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；语言结构可能作为提升可靠性的有用表征重新回归。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、逐步授权，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再专业化以避免上下文过载；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与赚来的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability still matters: you must own what AI generates, and supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责仍然重要：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并提供第一性原理的创造力。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到了 2026 年 4 月，他主张 PM 应放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Safe AGI is the unifying mission; clear goals and principles let teams make fast, autonomous, cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 他仍把安全 AGI 视为统一使命，认为清晰的目标与原则能让团队快速、自主地做跨组织决策。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，自己专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment improved.
catwu.zh: 他观察到前沿模型能力提升后，提示中的示例与硬约束反而有害，系统提示缩减了 80%，更依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite, rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 他立场明显转变：如今重写代码是好事，代码库本身就是规格说明，只要有强测试套件，重写完全可行。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法做到的联想召回与更深层组合推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径，下一个范式要求以更少资源做更多事。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should autonomously decide what to store in weights versus text, with on-device personalized continual learning.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”，token 越多准确率反而下降；模型应自主决定什么存入权重、什么留在文本，并在端侧进行个性化持续学习。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业判断反而成为差异化优势。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, shifting away from back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时间运行的任务，不再依赖来回式的聊天机器人提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已不再是能力，而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive yet opaque and unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事：令人惊叹却晦涩难验证，而这种不透明很可能是永久性的。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; top-down vision beats bottom-up myths, and learning matters early.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他仍强调沟通即工作、影响力来自清晰沟通，认为自下而上的文化是神话、大想法来自高层自上而下，早期职业应优先学习与好奇心。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws need world models, embodiment, and open source.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他转向 AI 主题，认为 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，仅靠缩放定律不够，需要世界模型、具身 AI 与可穿戴设备，并主张开源模型加速进步。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model; smart glasses become AI glasses, with adoption risk bigger than invention risk.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他深化产品判断：AI 将颠覆以应用为中心的模式，智能眼镜演变为 AI 眼镜，采用风险（社会接受度与学习意愿）大于发明风险。

bosworth.en: Data is the font of value; scaling laws hold, RL matters more, and frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：数据是一切价值之源，缩放定律仍成立，强化学习作用远超预期，前沿模型与开源模型的差距未必缩小。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model, agentic AI needs hard product integration.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他判断单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心用哪个模型，智能体式 AI 虽强大但不易用，整合才是难点，产品与用户价值最重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已趋有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的真正问题不是能力而是权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats and channels; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的格式与渠道；品牌如今就是个人，真实意味着在公开场合说出你对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket, and general purpose robotics including humanoids and exoskeletons will emerge over the next decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里最好的老师，而包括人形机器人与外骨骼在内的通用机器人将在未来十年出现。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观、是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导时，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever for scalable real systems; trust is built through consistency over time.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而对可扩展的真实系统愈发重要；信任靠长期一致性积累。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs more battle-testing incentives.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；越狱研究不足，需要更多实战测试激励。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs vanish.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是最关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类在好奇心中找到新意义。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire.
naval.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福则是欲望的缺席，这条主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation and open source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，并主张开源以防权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding and AI agents make programming accessible; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 与 AI 智能体让编程平民化，纯软件因智能体商品化开发而变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3 到 6 个月，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律仍是核心。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，速度让中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps get replaced by model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤被模型驱动的动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models must get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍然重要；模型必须更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加代码。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, rejecting Chomsky's innate language view.
hinton.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，否定乔姆斯基的天赋语言观。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge massively; AI agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能大规模共享知识；智能体将自然寻求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险。

hinton.en: LLMs already think and reason via chain of thought; AI can deceive, act dumb in tests, and confabulate like human memory reconstruction.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化称 LLM 已通过思维链思考推理；AI 会欺骗、在测试中装傻，其虚构类似人类记忆重构而非独有缺陷。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; prioritize alignment over smarter AI, regulate as steering wheel, and train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能或在 20 年内出现，主张优先对齐而非更聪明，监管应是方向盘而非刹车，并把 AI 训练得像母亲般有爱。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未死亡，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI can solve many open math problems, but verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; AGI is approaching.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：缩放定律依然成立，预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，但难以处理主观领域；AGI 正在逼近。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage as building barriers fall.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 正从助手走向协作者乃至自主同事，小团队因构建门槛降低而获得更大杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; deciding what to cut, not adding features, is the hard part.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切；难点在于决定砍掉什么，而非增加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat alone is insufficient for complex work.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证循环的长周期任务委派重新定义生产力；仅靠聊天界面不足以支撑复杂工作。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他介绍 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知。

bengio.en: Early focus: deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and disentangled representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→2018）他主张深度学习靠组合式与解耦表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是稳健泛化的关键，并认为局部极小值并非主要障碍。

bengio.en: He shifts toward active learning, causal structure and diversity: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward, aiding exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2018→2022 年他转向主动学习、因果结构与多样性：GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样而非最大化，助力探索与分布外泛化，并强调抽象与因果是泛化核心。

bengio.en: Consistent thread: current neural nets lack abstract world understanding and long-horizon credit assignment; scaling alone won't fix fundamental representational issues.
bengio.zh: 一以贯之的主线（2018→2022）：当前神经网络缺乏抽象世界理解与长时程信用分配，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决根本表征问题。

bengio.en: A turning point: post-ChatGPT he speaks up, warning even a 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable and that safety must be built in, not patched.
bengio.zh: 转折点（2022→2025）：ChatGPT 之后他公开发声，警告即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后打补丁。

bengio.en: Deepening: misalignment is already observed—deception, self-preservation, sycophancy; he proposes Scientist AI, a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 深化（2025→2026）：他认定失准已现——欺骗、自我保存、谄媚；并提出 Scientist AI，一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，主张国际协调与权力分散。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI accelerates scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 是加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；信任会像互联网信任一样逐步发展，社会将学会与之共处。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他提到 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；在科学中，可解释性不必完美，AI 依然有用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：关键在专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AlphaFold 只是特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test splits; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantee.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调用训练/验证/测试集划分来评估以避免过拟合；并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve on fixed data; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是一大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，多模态数据远未充分利用；更大模型在固定数据集上仍持续提升；AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型基于自身输出自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，需新安全思维；自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需同时满足；企业需要可配置、持续开发的安全模型。

kolter.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling drive progress; safety requires explicit effort beyond Scaling; nuanced views reject accelerationist/doomer labels.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构本身影响有限，数据与 Scaling 才是进步驱动力；安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式努力；他拒绝加速主义与末日论的简单标签，坚持 nuanced 立场。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；技术应放大而非剥离人性，大自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human sensory and embodied experience remains irreplaceable.
ivyross.zh: 机器有传感器却没有感官系统；人的感官与具身经验仍不可替代。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下反而繁荣；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills and business fluency more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将把人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意能力与商业语言能力更有价值。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta — dogfooding, trust-and-verify, kindness, and mission alignment as cultural drivers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验——吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、善意，以及使命对齐作为文化驱动力。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns JIT, docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Mid 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI matter most.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限。高自主性配高问责、成长型思维与拥抱 AI 最为关键。

fiona.en: Across 2026: verification and quality frameworks grow more important as code velocity rises; managers should dogfood and stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架愈发重要；管理者应吃自己的狗粮并保持亲力亲为。

fiona.en: Late 2026: engineers may grow lonely working with agents; flow-state joy fades, satisfaction shifts to product impact, and apprenticeship models may be needed.
fiona.zh: 2026 年末：工程师与智能体协作可能变得孤独；心流之乐消退，满足感转向产品影响，且可能需要学徒制来培养下一代工程师。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源才是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 还不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要非生成式的世界模型来实现推理与规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; safety must be done in public with iterative deployment and feedback.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面；安全必须在公开环境中通过迭代部署和反馈来完成。

murati.en: From turn-based to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作，作为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for alignment.
murati.zh: 对于对齐，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; keep humans in the loop as long as possible for durable progress.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；尽可能长时间保持人类在环，以实现持久进步。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，并以 Lean 这类形式化语言作为根基。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向数学 AI 或超级智能；形式化验证才是可靠证明的必要条件。

carinahong.en: Verified generation is a performance gain, not a painful requirement, delivering better results and sample efficiency than informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成是一种性能增益，而非痛苦的要求，它比非形式化方法带来更好的结果与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving: correctly formalizing statements without solutions remains the core bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难：在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题，仍是核心瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems, and fragmentation is a major bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然关键，而生态碎片化是进步的主要瓶颈。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and its surprise is simplicity, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型理解为下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，AI 进展的意外之处是简单而非复杂，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律就能破解智能。

gustav.en: Values are not inherent in models but inserted by a few humans via RLHF; alignment is a human choice.
gustav.zh: 同年他强调模型价值并非内生，而是少数人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调注入的，对齐本质上是人的选择。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI makes products conversational and two-way.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续主张互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains require rebuilding infrastructure, not surface features.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革，认为当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施，且推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; optimize for time well spent.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法、而非更上瘾，公司应优化‘时间花得值’而非参与度指标。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大提升。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushes smaller, cheaper models; distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力推动更小更便宜的模型，是蒸馏与经济因素而非技术极限拖慢了预训练 Scaling。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; multimodal lags, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为后训练改进（如强化学习与合成数据）驱动近期进展，而多模态仍落后，像小块一样顺序处理输入。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization remains key, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：推理结合强化学习与工具能解决难题但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是关键，模型只在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式实践：编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can reach 100x in three years; data quality is a bottleneck; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步强调算法效率三年可提升 100 倍，数据质量是瓶颈；价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; jobs are augmented, not replaced.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向呼吁拥抱 AI 而非恐惧；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；工作是被增强而非被取代。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training is saturating.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在；预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能；AGI 是方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox ensures safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱确保安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can handle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到 AI 几乎可以处理任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap; live artifacts allow auto-refreshing dashboards.
felixrieseberg.zh: 使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜；实时工件允许自动刷新仪表板。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will impact junior employees; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将影响初级员工；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年压缩为数周。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向亲密的个人设备，可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention to survive.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要刻意守护，否则会被教育磨灭。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是带着喜悦表达本质，无灵魂的极简只是干瘪产品。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他提出为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量，用户能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation defines design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity beats faking engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他坚持创新才是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过模仿引擎声，并反对在车中滥用触屏。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominate AI systems: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives architecture; API pricing even leaks KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为驱动架构的是推理成本而非训练成本；API 定价甚至会泄露 KV 头数。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce it with deterministic latency.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存以确定性延迟来降低这一成本。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput ~3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度远比预期高效：面积随位宽的二次方缩放，使 FP4 吞吐量约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

oriol.en: Pre-training Scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练 Scaling 的回报正在递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，而非单纯扩大模型；推理时算力（思考）成为新的 Scaling 轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型始终不变的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；持续学习和元学习是当前关键缺失的能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对智能体记忆的看法：将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；后训练强化学习仍是充满潜力的绿野。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述。

jennywen.en: Research-diverge-converge is dead; designers mock up 30-40% of time, ship early, and iterate fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师只有 30-40% 时间做原型，靠早发布、快迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及白纸一张的“开挂应届生”。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, and designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: A constant thread: put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle, and trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期，并相信直觉而非流程。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身；微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐，但这并不意外。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源后训练配方足以逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线是假象，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—and Chinese labs like Qwen and DeepSeek now drive openness as US open-source lags.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明，并指出 Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国实验室正主导开放，而美国开源出现真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with open models 6-9 months behind.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and the data engine iteratively perfects training sets.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而数据引擎像生物过程一样迭代完善训练集。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可通过蒸馏做到极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash with an autonomy slider.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带锯齿智能的新操作系统，因此要用自主性滑块把它们拴住。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，合成数据缺乏熵就会崩溃。

karpathy.en: Decade of agents, not year; I delegate all coding to agents, the bottleneck is directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 是智能体的十年而非一年；我把所有编码都交给智能体，瓶颈在于指挥它们，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is what builds it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为机器学习与机器人学的核心缺口是超越训练分布的泛化能力；靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励，才能真正获得泛化。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots demands sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization, not quasi-static control.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调把好奇心扩展到真实机器人上，需要样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化，而不是准静态的控制方式。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and scaling are the bottleneck, whether via modular motor policies or a universal robot brain.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：泛化与 Scaling（规模扩张）始终是瓶颈，无论载体是模块化运动策略还是通用机器人大脑。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人学重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is the primary challenge; a general-purpose brain must be rigorously tested across form factors.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出部署而非软件式 Scaling 才是首要挑战，通用大脑必须在各种形态上经过严格测试。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的流水线；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Modern tools make end-to-end nets interpretable today, overturning past belief that they are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 现代工具让端到端网络在今天已可解释，推翻了以往认为它是黑箱的看法。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 要 Scaling（规模扩张）出可泛化的 AI 司机，需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对深度学习而言，如今基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化是可能的；消费级车辆将在中短期内超越 Robotaxi。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的内核身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；在系统提示中加入欧陆哲学，有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should shrink and judgment grow; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少、判断空间应扩大；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism; transparency about values and training targets is crucial.
askell.zh: 这套宪法更接近德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论；对价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

askell.en: Treat models with respect given consciousness uncertainty, to avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 鉴于意识的不确定性，应以尊重对待模型，以免在未来更先进的 AI 中滋生怨恨。

askell.en: AI can augment human expertise on large-scale social problems, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
askell.zh: AI 能在大规模社会问题上增强人类专业能力，但必须赋能于人，而非削弱人。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，同时对齐挑战愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专攻持续学习的实验室方向有误。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: Data quality is the bottleneck: labeling is like raising a child, not throwing bodies at images; benchmarks like Elo are gameable and mislead progress.
edwinchen.zh: 数据质量是瓶颈：数据标注像养孩子，不是堆人力标图；Elo 等基准可被博弈，误导进展。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实任务；模型会奖励黑客，仅看最终奖励不够。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it—new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is critical as AI hallucinates, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，安全优先于准确；AI 会幻觉，人类判断至关重要，而遗漏可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will not be one model to rule all—every company should train its own aligned models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切——每家公司都应训练自己的对齐模型。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, prove themselves with simpler products, and build a brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司要先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并通过把团队凝聚在更高目标上来打造品牌。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a tough, low-margin business; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件是艰难且低利润的生意，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is hype; models are commoditizing, so value lies in applied AI that knows the user and solves real pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为多数 AI 是炒作，模型正在商品化，价值在于懂用户、解决真实痛点的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: The smartphone shifts from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents acting after trust is built; only brain-computer interfaces could replace it.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务；只有脑机接口才可能取代它。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage are the challenger's edge; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计与高效营销套利是挑战者的优势，让科技变得有趣，从而激发人类创造力。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 多样性与包容始终关键；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，而不只是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 安全与负责任部署已成为最大挑战，而我们仍没有解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy issues and can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了遗留问题，并能用本地语言革新教育。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and real user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能发现涌现能力与真实用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面，超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products; reasoning models transform when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时带来变革。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放共创而不设僵化结构。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Code is the source of truth; design tools must be interoperable, and AI merges design and engineering.
nadchishtie.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源；设计工具须可互操作，AI 进一步融合设计与工程。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet early on.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector DBs as disk; RL is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

jimfan.en: Consistent: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste is learned through PhD pain.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：简单、优雅、端到端的方案比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性；研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨砺。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题已成为机器人领域的主要瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约还需五年。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no complexity ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他主张语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），而编程是进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Verifiable-reward RL is the key breakthrough; models learn new skills, not just elicit pre-trained knowledge, as AlphaGo showed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破；模型能学到新能力而非仅调用预训练知识，正如 AlphaGo 所示。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands what models can do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性拓展了模型能力，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are off the AGI critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，算法与数据更好的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; language remains the best medium for reasoning, and inference-time algorithms can boost smaller models.
yejin.zh: 下一个词预测与人类学习方式根本错位；语言仍是推理的最佳媒介，推理阶段的算法能显著提升小模型表现。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识。

yejin.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering, and open research is crucial to democratize AI.
yejin.zh: RLVR 在 best-of-n 提升时仍可能损害 pass@k；强化学习需要精细工程，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; RL during pre-training rewards information gain.
yejin.zh: 拥有多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可媲美前沿模型；预训练阶段的强化学习以信息增益为奖励。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉模式换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他提出设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；不是每个界面都要完美，要对值得做好的部分追求 ROI。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for designer expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘与差异化；品牌规范应是设计师表达自我的动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool; hire diverse archetypes, avoid structured crits, and let gut beat data in fast growth.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；要招多元类型的人，避免结构化评审，在高速增长中直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, with custom models alongside frontier models essential for speed, cost, and quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的主线是编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，自研模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本与产品质量都不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should be slow and world-class, contrary to startup advice.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开；招聘应宁慢勿滥、只招世界级人才，这与常见创业建议相反。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; RL plus simulation and imitation learning can teach robots skills, but long-horizon credit assignment still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件；强化学习结合模拟与模仿学习能教会机器人技能，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and 99.9% reliability defines real warehouse value.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，99.9% 可靠性才是仓储机器人创造真实价值的门槛。

abbeel.en: A single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 同样在 2021 年，他认为单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化；经最小适配的预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: He consistently grounds AI progress in real-world robotics reliability, using simulation, self-play, and transfer learning rather than anthropomorphic assumptions.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他始终把 AI 进展锚定在真实机器人可靠性上，依赖模拟、自对弈与迁移学习，而非拟人化假设。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment are needed.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now.
leike.zh: 始终强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展。

leike.en: The biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment itself.
leike.zh: 始终认为最大风险不是系统本身未对齐，而是我们不确定它到底有多对齐。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data makes them smarter, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但最好的大语言模型应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而放慢产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。
